svg.aria-label: 11 frames drawn on the five need lines: one that holds all five needs, then ten grouped by the paradox each one moves. A station marks a need the frame builds on; joined stations are the needs it lets a person have at once. The table below lists every station.
svg.text: One Frame, and the Ten It Holds

Each row is a frame, an analogy: a place people already know where they get these needs at once, without being paid to be there. The first holds all five; the rest are grouped by the paradox each moves.
Dorst’s step 6, Frames. Built Nov 9, 2026 from the five needs on the field themes map. Hover a station for how the frame builds on that need; every station is in the table below.

ONE FRAME FOR ALL FOUR
Holds: all five needs, and all four paradoxes, at once
SEEING THE ROUTE, MAKING YOUR OWN
Pulls apart: Coherence and Becoming, the README’s hunch
SEEN AS YOURSELF, PART OF A TEAM

A PERSON AT EVERY CROSSING
Pulls apart: Support for the newcomer and for the organizer
WHEN THE CYCLE ENDS
Pulls apart: Belonging and the deadline

circle.title: The Quilting Bee, Mattering: every block signed by its maker, and the quilt given to someone
The Quilting Bee, Coherence: one pattern, one block size, for everyone
The Quilting Bee, Support: newcomers learn at the frame beside people who’ve quilted for years
The Quilting Bee, Belonging: the bee meets again for the next quilt
The Quilting Bee, Becoming: from your first block to patterns of your own

svg.text: Friendship quilts, round robins, the bee at the frame
Nothing has to choose: the pattern holds, the fabric and the hand are yours

circle.title: The Camino, Coherence: the way is marked and holds still
The Camino, Support: hosts who walked it themselves stamp the passport
The Camino, Becoming: your pace, your reasons; a passport records how far you’ve come

svg.text: The pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela
The route stops being one path; the marks and the stamps hold still

circle.title: The Ski Resort, Coherence: signs at every junction, rated against this mountain
The Ski Resort, Support: a ski school and a patrol for when you need them
The Ski Resort, Becoming: you choose by skill and mood, and move up

svg.text: Trail ratings, ski school and patrol
One path gives way to rated runs you choose between

circle.title: The CrossFit Box, Coherence: one workout, on the whiteboard, for everyone
The CrossFit Box, Support: a coach in every class
The CrossFit Box, Belonging: the same people at the same hour
The CrossFit Box, Becoming: scaled to where you are, so you can do it today

svg.text: One workout on the whiteboard, scaled for each person
Everyone does the same session; how hard is yours to set

circle.title: The Film Credits, Mattering: named for what you did, in words an employer can read
The Film Credits, Belonging: the list belongs to the film, not to any one name

svg.text: Film credits; science’s CRediT roles
The ranking: every role on one list, no order of names

circle.title: The Relay, Mattering: your leg is yours, timed and seen
The Relay, Support: a teammate hands off to you, and waits at the wall
The Relay, Belonging: one result, shared by the team

svg.text: Relay swimming
Your leg is timed and seen, and the result is the team’s

circle.title: The Train Station, Coherence: the board shows every way on from here
The Train Station, Support: a staffed desk at every station to ask

svg.text: Departure boards and a staffed desk; patient navigators
A person per station, not per traveler

circle.title: The Doula, Coherence: what’s happening, explained in plain words
The Doula, Support: someone beside you the whole way across
The Doula, Becoming: feeling in control, and more sure you can

svg.text: Birth companions
Continuous support, given by someone who just crossed

circle.title: The Tailor’s Shop, Support: beside people one step ahead
The Tailor’s Shop, Belonging: inside the shop’s real work from the first day
The Tailor’s Shop, Becoming: from small real tasks toward the centre

svg.text: Apprenticeship, as Lave and Wenger found it
Helping stops being extra hours; it’s the helper’s next step

circle.title: The Harbor, Support: people who expect you, and are there when needed
The Harbor, Belonging: a crew keeps its berth between voyages
The Harbor, Becoming: a safe harbor is what lets people sail out again

svg.text: A ship’s home port; Recurse Center; Civic Tech DC
The Cycle’s claim to be the whole of The Labs

circle.title: parkrun, Mattering: every helper counted, and nobody finishes last
parkrun, Coherence: same time, same place, always on
parkrun, Belonging: the same people, every week, with no season to sign up for

svg.text: The free 5 km, every Saturday morning
The Cycle as the only way in
Mattering
“I want someone to see what I can do, and for
it to count.”
4 of 11 frames; 27 of 50 in the field
Coherence
“I need this to make sense: where I am, what’s
next, and that I can handle it.”
7 of 11 frames; 14 of 50 in the field
Support
“I don’t want to face the hard part by myself.”
9 of 11 frames; 17 of 50 in the field
Belonging
“I want a place, and people, that are still
mine when this ends.”
7 of 11 frames; 18 of 50 in the field
Becoming
“I want to believe I can become someone new,
and that I’m allowed to.”
7 of 11 frames; 9 of 50 in the field
The frame builds on this need
Joined: the needs the frame lets a person have at once, like the platforms of an interchange. An open station on the link is a need it also touches.
